name: pulse
description: Self-hostable web analytics + uptime monitoring for developers

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,ingest -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:ingest"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pulse/ingest && npm run build -w @pulse/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
